comment.narrative: EUNEIGHBOURS east AS 2019 EaP OVerviewThe EUfunded EU NEIGHBOURS east project has conducted the 2019 opinion poll in the six countries of the Eastern Partnership EaP Armenia Azerbaijan Belarus Georgia the Republic of Moldova and Ukraine. The survey took place between February and April 2019 and was based upon facetoface interviews among a representative sample of 1000 people per country. The annual surveys are now into their fourth year with the first wave having been carried out in 2016. The results from the six countries are presented in national reports and a consolidated regional overview report.Here below are the key findings in the Republic of Moldova more details may be found in the factsheets and report at the links indicated below. MAIN FINDINGS 65 of people in the Republic of Moldova trust the European Union. 85 of Moldovans are aware of the EUs financial support 53 of whom consider the support to be effective. 68 of Moldovans believe the relations with the European Union are good. Over half of Moldovan citizens 55 have a positive image of the European Union EU 33 feel neutral about it and only 10 hold a negative view

The great majority of citizens positively acknowledge the relationship with the EU 78 up 4 percentage points since 2022 and are aware of the EUs financial support to their country 81 up 3 percentage points. Over half of Moldovans acknowledge its effectiveness 54.Among citizens aware of the EUs financial support 21 know of specific programmes nearlyall of which have been personally involved with an EUfunded project in the twelve months before the survey 19. Both figures have increased compared to last year by around 5.

comment.narrative: EUNEIGHBOURS east AS 2019 EaP OVerviewThe EUfunded EU NEIGHBOURS east project has conducted the 2019 opinion poll in the six countries of the Eastern Partnership EaP Armenia Azerbaijan Belarus Georgia the Republic of Moldova and Ukraine. The survey took place between February and April 2019 and was based upon facetoface interviews among a representative sample of 1000 people per country. The annual surveys are now into their fourth year with the first wave having been carried out in 2016. The results from the six countries are presented in national reports and a consolidated regional overview report.Here below are the key findings in the Republic of Moldova more details may be found in the factsheets and report at the links indicated below. MAIN FINDINGS 65 of people in the Republic of Moldova trust the European Union. 85 of Moldovans are aware of the EUs financial support 53 of whom consider the support to be effective. 68 of Moldovans believe the relations with the European Union are good. Over half of Moldovan citizens 55 have a positive image of the European Union EU 33 feel neutral about it and only 10 hold a negative view

The great majority of citizens positively acknowledge the relationship with the EU 78 up 4 percentage points since 2022 and are aware of the EUs financial support to their country 81 up 3 percentage points. Over half of Moldovans acknowledge its effectiveness 54.Among citizens aware of the EUs financial support 21 know of specific programmes nearlyall of which have been personally involved with an EUfunded project in the twelve months before the survey 19. Both figures have increased compared to last year by around 5.
